column1: # LOSAT -db fixtures (db_search_fixtures.py): rows that run `LOSAT PROGRAM -db DB -query QUERY EXTRA_ARGS -outfmt OUTFMT` from LOSAT/ (program: blastp, blastn, tblastn, blastx or tblastx).

# kind ncbi: stdout, stderr and exit status (rc) equal the frozen bytes of NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `PROGRAM -db ... -num_threads 1` (LOSAT/tests/fixtures/db_search/<row_id>.out, .err when stderr is not empty).
# kind losat-rejection: LOSAT exits with rc, stdout is empty, stderr contains the text after `expect: ` in covers (to a ` | ` or the end); the hash columns are empty.

# Rows db.ps.* (line PS, PS1): psiblast's first round against tests/db_search/paja, the queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ (WSSV proteins of tests/fasta/WSSV.faa and constructed records); the ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `psiblast -db ... -num_threads 1`.
# Rows db.sa.*.5 (OF4a): -outfmt 5 (BLAST XML) of BLASTN and BLASTP, each the search of the db.sa.*.8 row of the same stem (stdout is the XML document; hit ids gnl|BL_ORD_ID|N).

# Rows db.sa.{blastx,tblastn,tblastx}.*.5 and db.x5.* (OF4b): the same for BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX; db.x5.* use the mixed query files tests/fasta/outfmt0/x5_* (each with a query without hits), db.x5.*.nohit_all has no hit for any query.

# Rows db.sa.*.1[56], db.x16.* and db.x16_*taxid.* (OF5a for BLASTP and BLASTN, OF5b for BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX): -outfmt 16 (BLAST XML2) and 15 (BLAST JSON) of all five programs, the search of the .5 or .8 row of the same stem where the covers cell says so; BLASTDB=DIR, BATCH_SIZE=N and ARCHIVE_FORMAT=X tokens in extra_args are environment variables of the NCBI run and of LOSAT's.
# db: path relative to LOSAT/ (an empty cell is -db ""); extra_args is split like a shell line; outfmt is one argument; stdout_sha256, stdout_bytes and stderr_sha256 are written by `freeze`.

# Rows db.sa.* (line OF, OF3b): -outfmt 8 (Seq-annot, ASN.1 text) and 12 (Seq-annot, JSON) and, in the ids ending .9 (OF3c), 9 (Seq-annot, binary ASN.1; the fixture files are binary, see fixtures/db_search/.gitattributes); freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.`.

# Rows db.x16.blastx.mix.13, db.sa.x16_ttaxid.good.13, db.sa.x16_xtaxid.good.14 (OF5c part 2, BLASTX, TBLASTN and TBLASTX): the same for the programs of part 2, the search of the .16 row of the same stem.

# Rows db.sa.*.1[34] (OF5c, BLASTP and BLASTN): -outfmt 14 and 13 (side files and a master file) of the search of the .16/.15 row of the same stem. The files column is xinclude: the runner adds `-out <tmp>/<row_id>.out`; the master is frozen as <row_id>.out (stdout_sha256, stdout_bytes; standard output is empty), the side files as <row_id>.out_<n>.xml|json (side_sha256, in order). A row of the old form has 12 cells and no files columns (LOSAT/tests/xinclude_fixtures.py).

# Rows db.numdesc.* (line NP, O1b): -num_descriptions and -num_alignments (blast_args.cpp:2894-2973); the last one is NCBI's error for a hit list size of 0 (rc 1, empty stdout); freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.numdesc.`.
# Rows db.blastp.culling_* and db.tblastn.culling_* (line NP, O3b): -culling_limit with -db; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.blastp.culling_` / `--only db.tblastn.culling_`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.bn.* (line OF, OF8a): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of BLASTN with `-db tests/db_search/arch_snucl`, each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.tbn.* (line OF, OF8b2): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of TBLASTN with `-db tests/db_search/arch_tbn_snucl` (version 4, no -parse_seqids: makeblastdb -in tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbn_s.fna -dbtype nucl -title snucdb -blastdb_version 4; .nhr .nin .nsq kept), each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.tbn.`.

# Rows db.sa.arch.tbx.* (line OF, OF8b3): -outfmt 11 (BLAST archive, ASN.1 text; ARCHIVE_FORMAT=bin|BIN: binary; =foo: nothing) of TBLASTX with `-db tests/db_search/arch_tbx_snucl` (version 4, no -parse_seqids: makeblastdb -in tests/fasta/outfmt11/arch_tbx_s.fna -dbtype nucl -title snucdb -blastdb_version 4; .nhr .nin .nsq kept), each with the .8 and .5 rows of the same search so that check_archive_layout.py predict rebuilds the archive; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sa.arch.tbx.`.

# Rows db.wm.* (line NP, M2): blastn -window_masker_db (counts tests/winmask/counts/mg1655_u9.obinary) against the database tests/db_search/wm_s60k (README.md there); the masks of each query chunk are those of its own letters (CHUNK_SIZE=600 and 400), also with -strand minus (the reverse complement's intervals); the -subject rows are the wm.* cases of tests/blastn_regression_fixtures.py. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --ncbi-bin DIR --only db.wm.
# Rows db.score.tblastx.* (line NP, series SCT, SC7): TBLASTX -matrix with -db (the rows score.tblastx.* of outfmt0_manifest.tsv are the -subject ones).

# Rows db.id.* (line DBID, ID2a): BLASTP and BLASTX against the databases with parsed Seq-ids tests/db_search/ids/prot_v5 and prot_v4 (make_ids.py: every Seq-id form, several definition lines, GIs, titles NCBI makes from the Seq-ids), every format they write (version 4: outfmt 0, 5, 6); the queries tests/db_search/ids/ids_q.faa and ids_q.fna (the second hits weakly, the third not at all). With BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/good the XML2 and JSON descriptions name each taxid (db.id.*.taxdb*; refuse_v5 holds a taxid that taxonomy database does not know between two it knows). Rejection rows: subjects whose Seq-align ids match (NCBI joins their hits in outfmt 0, 5 and 13 to 16; tests/seqid/db/variants), sequences NCBI's formatters do not find by their Seq-align id (bbs|, gnl|PIG|, nat|; query ids_qw.faa; lcl|777 before gi|777), a title NCBI makes from the taxonomy database, the records of tests/db_search/ids/refuse_v5 (make_ids.py: titles whose end NCBI rewrites from the taxids, an outfmt 0 description id over 65 bytes and a title of punctuation, both of which NCBI's outfmt 0 does not end on; each query hits its own record alone with -evalue 1e-20), psiblast (BLASTX makes these refusals of a batch's reported sequences after the first lines of outfmt 0, as its other refusals of reported sequences; it holds outfmt 5 and 13 to 16 of a database with parsed Seq-ids, so those documents are dropped).

# Rows db.id.{blastn,tblastn,tblastx}.* (line DBID, ID2b): BLASTN (megablast; -task blastn and dc-megablast in db.id.blastn.{blastn,dc}.*), TBLASTN and TBLASTX against the nucleotide databases with parsed Seq-ids tests/db_search/ids/nucl_v5 and nucl_v4 (make_ids.py: the Seq-id forms of tests/seqid/fasta/nucl_ids.fa with the GenBank, EMBL and DDBJ accessions each under prefixes of its own partner, several definition lines, GIs, titles NCBI makes from the Seq-ids), every format they write (version 4: outfmt 0, 5, 6); queries tests/seqid/fasta/qnucl.fa and qprot.fa (the second has no hit); TBLASTN and TBLASTX with -max_hsps 1. Rejection rows: lcl|777 before gi|777 (nrefuse_v5; NCBI's formatters do not find the sequence by gi|777), gb|AF000040.1| and gb|AF000040| in the two volumes of the alias njoined (NCBI joins their hits in outfmt 0, 5 and 13 to 16), a title NCBI makes from the taxonomy database (BLASTN and TBLASTX make these refusals after the first lines of outfmt 0, as their other refusals of reported sequences).

# Rows db.tm.* (line DBID, item T): NCBI's messages about the taxonomy database (BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/<variant>) in the formats that prefetch the reported subjects (outfmt 0, 5, 6, 7, 17), all five programs: the open messages (bad_magic, count_larger), the volume lookup of a taxid at the last index entry (offset_last_past_end, databases x16_*taxid_99990), several batches (BATCH_SIZE=100), a batch whose first queries have warnings of their own (x16_*qinv: letters that give no Karlin-Altschul parameters, a query without letters), a database with parsed Seq-ids, and a taxonomy database without messages (good). Review 1 (db.tm.bp.fast.*, db.tm.bp.2vol.*, db.tm.*.cache*): blastp-fast with two query blocks (tests/db_search/tm_fast_q289.faa), an alias of two volumes (tests/db_search/tm_2vol), and the volumes tm_cache150 (refused: a taxid of the slot of the offset error's taxid in NCBI's per-volume taxonomy cache) and tm_cache151 (its control); tests/db_search/README.md says how they were made.

# Rows db.tfast.* (line DI4, dropin-survey-20261029): TBLASTN -task tblastn-fast and -word_size 6 and 7 with -db (the database tests/db_search/tfast_amr of synthetic contigs with AMR genes, and tslice), AMRFinderPlus's two tblastn calls; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.tfast.`.

# Rows db.sc1.* (line NP, series SC, SC1): TBLASTN -matrix, -gapopen and -gapextend with -db (tests/db_search/tslice) in composition modes 0 and 2, IDENTITY's reset to mode 0 with its warnings; freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.sc1.`.

# Rows db.tab.bn.* (line CLI, C2): BLASTN custom tabular reports (-outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>") with -db: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field on databases with and without -parse_seqids and with taxids (nslice, ids/nucl_v4, ids/nucl_v5, x16_ntaxid), the taxdb cases (staxids with a taxdb: ncbi; sscinames with a taxdb: losat-rejection), delim= forms, NCBI's delimiter error (rc 1), -query_loc, the ABRicate call and dc-megablast; the -subject rows are tab.bn.* in outfmt0_manifest.tsv. Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.tab.bn.`.

# Rows db.tab.bp.* and db.tab.bx.* (line CLI, C2, PR 3): BLASTP and BLASTX custom tabular reports (-outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>") with -db: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field on databases with and without -parse_seqids and with taxids (ids/prot_v5, ids/prot_v4, x16_taxid, paja), outfmt 10 and 20, delim= forms, NCBI's delimiter error (rc 1, stderr only), -query_loc (BLASTP only: LOSAT's BLASTX refuses -query_loc), the Galaxy and nf-core calls (corpus GAL10, NFC07) and the ABRicate call (X04); the -subject rows are tab.bp.* and tab.bx.* in outfmt0_manifest.tsv, the taxonomy database names are db.tab.names.*. Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.tab.bp.` / `freeze --only db.tab.bx.`.

# Rows db.tab.names.* (line CLI, C2, PR 3): the taxonomy database names (ssciname scomname sblastname sskingdom and the plural sscinames scomnames sblastnames sskingdoms) of BLASTN, BLASTP and BLASTX with -db and BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/<variant> (the db.tm.* variants): the good database (outfmt 6, 10 and 20; a scientific name with quotes, a comma and a semicolon: taxid 7777), a taxid that the database does not know (taxdb_xml2/no_9606), NCBI's open message (bad_magic), empty fields, the volume lookup and offset error of the last index entry (offset_last_past_end, databases x16_*taxid_99990), and a parsed database with taxids (ids/prot_v5); freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.tab.names.`.

# Rows db.tab.tbn.* and db.tab.tbx.* (line CLI, C2b): TBLASTN and TBLASTX custom tabular reports (-outfmt "6|7|10|20 [delim=X] <fields>") with -db: every identifier, alignment and taxonomy field on databases with and without -parse_seqids and with taxids (tslice / xslice, ids/nucl_v4, ids/nucl_v5, x16_ntaxid), the taxdb cases (staxids with a taxdb: ncbi; sscinames with a taxdb: losat-rejection), delim= forms, NCBI's delimiter error (delim=/ with frames, rc 1), frames without a counts field, -query_loc, TBLASTN -db_gencode 4 / -matrix BLOSUM45 -word_size 2 -comp_based_stats 0, TBLASTX -query_gencode 4 -db_gencode 11, and the drop-in calls of CORPUS (T03, UNI02, MOB07, KLB03 for TBLASTN; TX03, GAL18 for TBLASTX); the -subject rows are tab.tbn.* and tab.tbx.* in outfmt0_manifest.tsv. Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.tab.tbn.` / `freeze --only db.tab.tbx.`.
